deal.product_description: The Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra is a premium 47mm LTE Titanium smartwatch designed for both style and functionality. It features a circular display made with durable materials suitable for outdoor activities, providing GPS tracking, health monitoring, and custom apps for various needs. The robust design integrates a range of smart features including notifications, music control, and heart rate tracking, making it an ideal companion for fitness enthusiasts and tech-savvy users alike.

The Refurbished Unlocked Apple iPhone 14 Pro Max offers an impressive 256GB storage and a huge display, perfect for both media consumption and productivity. Enjoy advanced camera technology for stunning photos. This model is designed to provide a seamless user experience with 5G capabilities for faster downloads and streaming. Refurbished to high standards, it comes in various colors and can support all the latest apps from the App Store, accommodating any Apple enthusiast's needs.

Ortizan C7 Powered Studio Monitor Speakers come as a stereo pair with Bluetooth 5.3 for wireless streaming plus multiple wired inputs (RCA, 3.5mm AUX, 6.35mm TRS) for connecting mixers or instruments. They include a built-in 24-bit DAC for digital audio over USB, a 3.5" carbon-fiber mid-bass driver, and a 0.75" silk-dome tweeter for accurate nearfield monitoring.

The Dreame Aqua Plus bone conduction open-ear headphones deliver audio without in-ear or over-ear pads by transmitting sound through bone conduction, leaving the ear canal open. They have an IP68 waterproof rating for rigorous outdoor or water-adjacent use and include 32GB of onboard storage so you can play music without a phone connection—useful for runs or swims where carrying a device is inconvenient.

Unlocked Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge (256GB) is a flagship Android phone with a 6.7" display, a titanium build paired with Corning Gorilla Glass Ceramic 2 for durability, and a high-resolution 200MP main camera. The device is sold unlocked for use with any carrier and includes top-tier hardware and a slim profile suitable for power users who want premium materials and imaging performance.

The Varpoolfaye 10,000-gallon 220V swimming pool heater is a high-capacity electric unit delivering roughly 35,100 BTU suitable for large above-ground pools up to 10,000 gallons. It offers dual heating and cooling modes, Wi‑Fi app control for temperature scheduling, a corrosion-resistant titanium heat exchanger, a wide operating temperature range (45°F–104°F), and quiet operation rated around 53 dB.

The iQuavia cordless robotic pool vacuum is a remote-controlled cleaner built for in-water autonomy, featuring 4WD traction to clean floors, walls, and waterlines with dual brushes and 5,500 GPH suction. It includes ultrasonic sensors for efficient navigation, remote steering for spot cleaning, and a 210‑minute cordless runtime with auto-park retrieval—designed to handle large pools without tethering to a power source.

A semi-solid-state 10,000mAh portable power bank with magnetic MagAir design for snap-on wireless charging of compatible phones. It supports 20W USB-C Power Delivery input and output for wired charging, includes a foldable kickstand for hands-free use, and an integrated lanyard cable for convenience. The semi-solid-state battery chemistry reduces bulk and heat compared with traditional lithium-ion packs, making it more compact and safer for everyday carry.

The Dreame Aqua 10 Ultra is a robot vacuum and mop with a self-emptying, self-cleaning dock that washes its mop roller at high temperature and supports up to ~100 days between manual dust bag changes. It features powerful 30,000 Pa suction, a detangling roller brush to reduce hair clogs, FlexRise air suspension to climb obstacles up to 3.15 in, and continuous fresh-water mopping with an AutoSeal roller guard to prevent carpet dampening.

HQST 200W N-Type monocrystalline solar panel built with high-efficiency N-Type cells rated at 25.4% and a 16-busbar design for improved current collection. The panel measures 46.3" x 30.1" x 1.2", weighs 20.2 lb., features an IP65 waterproof rating with a corrosion-resistant aluminum frame, and is rated to withstand substantial wind and snow loads with an expected service life up to 30 years and 87.4% output retention.

A 20-piece fragrance discovery set from Macy’s featuring 20 sample-size minis from high-end designers like Dolce & Gabbana, Givenchy, Lancôme, Prada, and Yves Saint Laurent, plus a 30 g eucalyptus-scented bath bomb. The kit is designed as a try-before-you-buy sampler, with many scents provided in 0.06 fl. oz. and 0.04 fl. oz. sizes, useful for travel or testing multiple perfumes without committing to full bottles.

A GE 24" top-control built-in dishwasher with a quiet 52-decibel operation and Dry Boost drying technology designed to dry plastics up to three times better than standard heated dry. Features include AutoSense wash cycles that detect soil level and adjust settings, an adjustable upper rack that fits items up to 10.5" tall, ENERGY STAR certification, and Active Flood Protect leak detection.
